learning_outcomes.text: To be able to explain the profession of Mechatronics Engineering, basic concepts and applications of engineering.
To be able to explain the functions of mechatronics engineers in the industry.
To be able to explain the actuators and sensors used in mechatronic systems and to select them appropriately.
To be able to explain the controllers and sensors used in mechatronic systems and to select them appropriately.
To be able to design, build, test a mechatronic system, and report and present the results with a small team.

syllabus_topics: Digital signals + digital logic Signal conditioning, microprocessors
System modeling, dynamic response of systems, control; I/O Systems
